title: BgReading : Received a bg reading that appears to be in the future
body:
Hi ,

In my Event List i see many many Lines wiht BgReading and the message Received a bg reading that appears to be in the future for example ( 2019-06-13  15:25.02 vs 2019-06-14 15:29:48) At that moment my phone has a time of 15:28 and my pump 15:27 because there is a different from about 45 seconds between pump and phone. I put off automatic time in Phone en when i started the pump, i set the phone on the same time. But sometimes i don't have these messages and sometime every 5 minutes. What can i do to avoid these. I have a S9, a combo. Thanx in advance

comments.body:
@Gosee1960 You should have both the phone and the pump to automatically update their time bases.
If the problem has been resolved, would you please close the issue?
Otherwise, you can post in the xDrip facebook group to ask for advice.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
Or in the xDrip room on Gitter.  https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
